title: Microsoft Internet Explorer setExpression Code Execution Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code on vulnerable installations of Microsoft Internet Explorer. User interaction is required to exploit this vulnerability in that the target must visit a malicious page. The specific flaw exists in the CRecalcProperty function in mshtml.dll. When rendering HTML after calling the setExpression methods, followed by a modification of the outerHTML property of a programatically created element. The vulnerable code dereferences a previously freed memory location which can be leveraged to execute arbitrary code.
